column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the locally previewed build (issue #28).
# The preview is plain vite preview over HTTP. These headers are added at the
# edge by CloudFront (provision/cloudformation/site.yaml), not by Vite, so
# alerting on them here only repeats what production already does.
# CSP is set at the CloudFront edge in production; keep ZAP alerting on it
# locally so regressions in the policy/content still surface in reports.

column3: (Anti-clickjacking Header) CloudFront response headers policy sets X-Frame-Options: DENY
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) CloudFront response headers policy sets nosniff
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set) CloudFront serves HTTPS and sets HSTS
